title: Selling spills into October after a 6.1% Sept fall

timeline.title: Worst nine-month run for markets in 15 years
timeline.line: Sensex is down 14.7% and Nifty 13.1% in 2026 so far; IT is down 27% and FMCG 19%
more: It is the weakest January–September showing in 15 years
Nifty ended August at 24,080.40, and the September series fell 5.70%
In 3 of 4 past nine-month losses, indices ended the year higher (2015 was the exception)

timeline.title: Selling spills into October after a 6.1% Sept fall
timeline.line: The Nifty lost 6.1% in September, and the new month has opened with a sharp sell-off
more: The Sensex hit a fresh calendar-year low today
The Nifty broke 22,400 for the first time since April 2
